article.story: LEXINGTON, Va. -- — Rickey Bradley Jr. had 14 points in VMI's 66-50 victory over Western Carolina on Wednesday night to stop a five-game losing streak. Bradley added seven rebounds for the Keydets (7-11, 1-4 Southern Conference). Augustinas Kiudulas added 14 points while shooting 4 for 11 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 5 of 5 from the free-throw line. Tan Yildizoglu had 14 points and shot 3 of 10 from the field, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line. Bernard Pelote led the way for the Catamounts (5-11, 1-4) with 14 points and six rebounds. Marcus Kell added 11 points. Both teams next play Saturday. VMI visits Citadel and Western Carolina plays UNC Greensboro at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
